import json, subprocess, re
manifest='/mnt/data/LSF/results/court/agentic_rule_full_data_gpt54mini_adaptive/all_docs/q09_which_judge_authored_the_majority_opinion.manifest.json'
out=subprocess.check_output(['python3','src/baseline/agentic_rule_full_data.py','list-docs','--manifest',manifest], cwd='/mnt/data/LSF')

for idx in sel:
    doc=arr[idx]
    path=doc['doc_path']
    with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
        text=f.read()
    lines=text.splitlines()
    hits=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines):
        if any(p.search(line) for p in patterns):
            hits.append((i+1,line.strip()))
    print('\\n###', idx, doc['doc_name'])
    for ln, line in hits[:20]:
        print(f'{ln}: {line[:220]}')
PY"
